summary:
Main
Price adjustments on reopening suggest that the soft expectations built during the holiday are feeding into domestic trading.DCE most-traded closed at 682.5 yuan/mt, down 2.85% from before the break; most mainstream Qingdao fines fell 15 yuan/wmt and PB Lump fell 17 yuan. The seaborne 61% index eased to USD 90.35/dmt and the 65% to 109.45, while all 12 brand quotations declined. Although mill enquiries resumed, SMM reported continued pressure on bids and only moderate trading, suggesting that lower prices have yet to attract significantly stronger demand.
